svg.title: ThingsBoard release-3.6 LwM2M: Bootstrap, Registration, Observe, Queue and Deregistration

g.text: ThingsBoard release-3.6 LwM2M: Bootstrap, Registration, Observe, Queue and Deregistration
Bootstrap and Main are separate servers.
Non-Finish response errors continue with the next task.
A Finish error fails the bootstrap session.
Credential validation waits synchronously up to LWM2M_TIMEOUT,
default 120000 ms. This is not a SQL transaction.
Uplink work is submitted to its executor.
The protocol response does not wait for platform initialization.
Read mapped paths that are not observed
Rule Engine processing and database commit are separate boundaries.
EMPTY callback prevents Queue errors from reaching the device.
There is no generic LwM2M business retry.
Registration UNREGISTERED race alone retries after 1 second, at most 5 times.
